newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-MOHANTY STAR OF INDIAN BOWLING.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-MOHANTY STAR OF INDIAN BOWLING.

text.p: Debutant Debasis Mohanty was the pick of the Indian bowlers as he claimed four wickets to send Sri Lanka packing for 332 in their first innings of the second final test match at Colombo on Sunday.

Sri Lanka, resuming at 316 for seven, could add only 16 more runs to their overnight score as Mohanty added the prize scalp of vice-captain Aravinda de Silva to his earlier wickets of Sanath Jayasuriya and Roshan Mahanama.

De Silva, who held the Sri Lanka innings together with a fine century on Saturday, added just two more runs to his overnight score of 144 before edging a catch to wicket-keeper Nayan Mongia off Mohanty's bowling.
He batted a total of 365 minutes and hit 20 fours.

Muthiah Muralitharan, the other batsman not out overnight, fell to leg-spinner Anil Kumble for 39, his highest test score, before Mohanty wrapped up the innings by claiming Ravindra Pushpakumara's wicket for no score.
